triplet: The Golden Goose: he who holds the goose holds the heat; everyone else a hanger-on, stuck.
The Lump of Silver: load to carry hurts my shoulder; Horse, Cow, Pig, then nothing but a stone.
The Straw, Coal, and Bean: impetuous coal tripped boldly; laughter split the belly seam.
The Turnip: compared to this vegetable, all the learning of the schools is empty air.
The Millstone: bird threw millstone down on her head, and she was crushed to death.
The Seven-Fly Girdle: giant read Seven at one stroke; respect for the tiny fellow.
The Poison Comb: Snowdrop's breath was stopped; fell as if dead until comb removed.
The Axe and Anvil: old man's beard caught in it; beard trap yields gold or lose beard.
The Bremen Pyramid: ass brayed, dog barked, cat mewed, cock screamed; terrify robbers.
The Seven Kids: wolf at the door; eaten, cut your way out of the belly, fill with stones.
The Ants and Ducks: we will remember you; one good turn deserves another, lost items.
The Twelve Princesses: every morning their shoes worn through, danced in all night.
The Talking Mirror: queen fairest in this land, but Snowdrop is lovelier; queen enraged.
The Chalk: wolf bought great lump of chalk; made his voice soft, rough voice disguised.
Falada's Head: alas, if thy mother knew it, sadly would she rue it; false bride truths.
The Juniper Bird: Kywitt, what a beautiful bird am I; a repetitive song causes madness.
The Wicked Stepmother: fool, we must all four die of hunger; two Child exiled for food.
The False Bride: I shall ride upon Falada, you may have my horse; identity theft.
Rumpelstiltskin: the devil told you that; spin straw into gold; guess his name, self-destruct.
The Cat of Kehrewit: up with the window, fling out my old man; replace with new suitor.
The Golden Bird: one feather no use to me; whole bird, but the golden cage alarm.
The Water of Life: waited till fast asleep, took it for themselves; bitter sea-water.
The Wishing Cloak: shoot into the midst of them; cloak falls too, mountain or castle.
The Table, Ass, and Stick: gold is good; a stick that beats people by itself is better.
The Gingerbread Cage: scream as he might, it would not help; finger checked for fatness.
The Witch's Oven: push her in, shut the iron door and bolt it; aggressor incinerated.
The Glass Mountain: every time he attempted to climb he fell back again, slippery slope.
The Barrel of Nails: dragged along by two white horses, street to street till she is dead.
Doctor Knowall: that man knows everything; accidental genius, luck or intimidation.
Clever Elsie: if pick-axe should fall on his head, have we not reason to weep for disaster.
The Three Languages: I learnt what dogs say when they bark; haunted tower treasure.
Hans's Logic: cast friendly eyes on her; cut calves' eyes, threw them in her face.
Iron Hans: my power great, greater than you think; gold and silver in abundance.
The Giant: such a great fellow, yet cannot carry tree; high strength, low intelligence.
The Bear Prince: you would not feel me between your teeth; take two wicked girls.
The Thirteenth Fairy: not asked to feast, set to work on revenge; castle put to sleep.
The Salad: scarcely swallowed when she lost her own form; donkey transformation.
The Blue Light: strike down that false judge; spare not the king; Black Dwarf summons.
Rampion: she would have died if she had not got some to eat; trade First Born for this.
The White Snake: king never took off cover to eat until alone; ducks and ants gossip.
The Golden Hair: tied handkerchief round head that man might not see; golden apple.
The Hazel Tree: shake, shake, hazel-tree, gold and silver over me; rags for ball gown.
The Severed Heel: cut the heel off to fit the shoe; as queen no longer go on foot.
The Peas in Ashes: good ones go into pot, bad ones into crop; opponent before the ball.
The Magic Wand: take away her magic wand or we cannot escape; transform into Lake or Flower.
The Drops of Blood: here on the stairs I am sweeping; distract the pursuer by delay.
The Sack of Wisdom: learning of schools is empty air; convince murderers of cosmic secrets.
The Wishing Ring: son with the power of wishing; receive exactly what you wish for.
Rapunzel's Braid: Rapunzel, let down your hair to me; climb out of reach, rope cut, fall.
The Fisherman's Wife: Ilsabill will have her own will; company, Godhood, pigsty.
Sleeping Beauty: thorns laid hold of them; stuck fast and died wretchedly, everyone sleeps.
Cat-Skin: scullion-girl, boots and shoes thrown at my head; conceal identity, golden dress.
